title: Theo and the Gravity
author: Hazel Underhill
blurb: Quentin Sterling, a xenolinguist who can no longer dream in human languages, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. But when the colony's children start sharing the same dream, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
